stem.text: A $\sigma$ bond is made between two carbon atoms in a molecule of ethene.
Which diagram shows the orbital overlap that occurs to form this bond?

A.alt: Two overlapping spheres of equal size, head-on overlap

B.alt: A sphere overlapping the lobe of a second orbital, lobe pointing right

C.alt: A small sphere at each end, with two lobes overlapping in the centre

D.alt: Four vertical lobes, two above and two below, overlapping side by side
